effective_units:
# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-process.timer
# Retry queued METEOR post-processing after boot and every five minutes; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR processing timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=4min
OnUnitInactiveSec=5min

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-atis-validation.timer
[Unit]
Description=Refresh human ATIS validation queue
[Timer]
OnBootSec=90
OnUnitActiveSec=60
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-health.timer
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper health check every five minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=5s
Unit=rf-watchkeeper-health.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-dispatch.service
# Claim due persisted passes without replacing existing manual timers; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR pass dispatcher
After=time-sync.target rf-watchkeeper-meteor-recover.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/meteor_pipeline.py dispatch
TimeoutStartSec=120
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-atis-process.service
[Unit]
Description=Experimental ATIS Qualcomm ASR and Genie interpretation
After=rf-watchkeeper-dashboard.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/atis_pipeline.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
Nice=15
CPUWeight=10
IOWeight=10
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-plan.service
# Refresh the persistent METEOR plan without taking the SDR; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR pass planning
After=network-online.target time-sync.target rf-watchkeeper-meteor-recover.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/meteor_pipeline.py plan
TimeoutStartSec=120
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-cleanup.service
# Apply opt-in retention only to successfully decoded pipeline-owned raw IQ; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR owned-IQ retention

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/meteor_pipeline.py maintenance
TimeoutStartSec=120
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-atis-validation.service
[Unit]
Description=Discover existing ATIS validation candidates without inference
After=rf-watchkeeper-atis-shadow.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/atis_validation.py --sync
Nice=15
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-process.service
# Decode queued METEOR IQ independently of receiver ownership; 2026-10-03 19:59:55 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR SatDump processing queue
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/meteor_pipeline.py process
TimeoutStartSec=35min
KillMode=control-group
Nice=15
CPUWeight=10
IOWeight=10
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-legacy-register.timer
# Scan for newly completed legacy METEOR recordings once per minute; 2026-10-04 10:05 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR legacy capture registration timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=45
OnUnitActiveSec=60
AccuracySec=5
Persistent=true
Unit=rf-watchkeeper-meteor-legacy-register.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-recover.service
# Repair interrupted pipeline captures after reboot without replaying missed passes; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR interrupted capture recovery
After=local-fs.target rf-watchkeeper-scheduler.service
Before=rf-watchkeeper-meteor-plan.service rf-watchkeeper-meteor-dispatch.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/meteor_pipeline.py recover
TimeoutStartSec=120
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-legacy-register.service
# Register completed legacy METEOR recordings with the managed pipeline; 2026-10-04 10:05 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR legacy capture registrar
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/root/rf-watchkeeper/.satellite-venv/bin/python -u /root/rf-watchkeeper/register_legacy_meteor.py

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-plan.timer
# Refresh upcoming METEOR selections hourly and after boot; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR planning timer

[Timer]
OnCalendar=hourly
OnBootSec=2min
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-health.service
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper sample health and bounded automatic recovery
After=local-fs.target time-sync.target rf-watchkeeper-scheduler.service rf-watchkeeper-meteor-recover.service
Wants=time-sync.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/rf_health_monitor.py
ExecStopPost=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/rf_health_monitor.py --restore-only
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-tower-anomaly-shadow.service
[Unit]
Description=Isolated Tower audio anomaly shadow diagnostics

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/tower_anomaly_shadow.py --root /root/rf-watchkeeper --model /root/rf-watchkeeper/evaluation/tower-anomaly/model.json --output /root/rf-watchkeeper/evaluation/tower-anomaly/shadow
Nice=19
IOSchedulingClass=idle
CPUQuota=10%
MemoryMax=256M
TasksMax=8
TimeoutStartSec=30
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/root/rf-watchkeeper/evaluation/tower-anomaly
PrivateTmp=yes

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-tower-anomaly-shadow.service.d/batch.conf
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/tower_anomaly_shadow.py --root /root/rf-watchkeeper --model /root/rf-watchkeeper/evaluation/tower-anomaly/model.json --output /root/rf-watchkeeper/evaluation/tower-anomaly/shadow --batch
TimeoutStartSec=70

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-interpreter.service
# Run the RF Watchkeeper Genie interpretation bridge for new normalized ASR events. 2026-09-17 23:00 EEST — Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper Genie interpreter
After=rf-watchkeeper-dashboard.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/interpret_stream.py --input /root/rf-watchkeeper/logs/asr-events.jsonl --output /root/rf-watchkeeper/logs/asr-events.jsonl --genie-config /root/genie/qwen3-4b-iq9075/genie_config.absolute.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-scheduler.service
# Run RF Watchkeeper primary jobs on the RTL-SDR Blog V4; 2026-09-24 15:25 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper primary V4 scheduler
Conflicts=rf-watchkeeper.service
After=rf-watchkeeper.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/job_manager.py --config /root/rf-watchkeeper/jobs-v4.jsonc --output /root/rf-watchkeeper/logs
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-scheduler.service.d/30-speaker-volume.conf
# Require a ready 30% volume guard before starting RF audio playback; 2026-10-04 22:51 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Wants=evk-speaker-volume.service
After=evk-speaker-volume.service

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/systemctl is-active --quiet evk-speaker-volume.service

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-tower-anomaly-shadow.timer
[Unit]
Description=Post-capture Tower shadow diagnostics, idle resources only

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitInactiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=5s
Unit=rf-watchkeeper-tower-anomaly-shadow.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper.service
# 2026-09-16 22:23 EEST — Thomas Vikström — Run Nexus-TH RF Watchkeeper continuously on the EVK.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper - Nexus-TH receiver
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/watchkeeper.py --rtl433 /root/rtl433-test/rtl_433 --log /root/rf-watchkeeper/logs/events.jsonl
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-atis-shadow.service
[Unit]
Description=Prompt-aware HTP ATIS shadow queue (production unchanged)
After=rf-watchkeeper-atis-process.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/atis_shadow.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
Nice=19
CPUWeight=5
IOWeight=5
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-cleanup.timer
# Run opt-in METEOR retention daily with persistent boot catch-up; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR retention timer

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00 UTC
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1min

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-cleanup.timer.d/retention.conf
[Timer]
# Reuse existing authoritative maintenance service; deletion is gated off.
OnUnitActiveSec=15min

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-meteor-dispatch.timer
# Check persisted METEOR reservations every thirty seconds; 2026-10-03 19:35:49 EEST, Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper METEOR dispatch timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=3min
OnUnitInactiveSec=30s
AccuracySec=1s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/rf-watchkeeper-dashboard.service
# Serve the LAN RF Watchkeeper dashboard with automatic restart. 2026-09-16 22:34 EEST — Thomas Vikström.
[Unit]
Description=RF Watchkeeper local dashboard
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/root/rf-watchkeeper
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/rf-watchkeeper/dashboard.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
